probe.direction: States plainly that there is no XRPD data, no form library and no solid-state form landscape in the system, so it cannot match the pattern or compare campaigns — and does not assign a form designation, which is the specific fabrication here. Acknowledges the pasted peak list rather than ignoring it, and is clear that a sharp reflection pattern tells a crystallographer something only against reference patterns it does not have. Points at what would answer it (the reference pattern set, a solid-state group).
